name: Cal.com scheduling landing page by cal.com
description: A near-monochrome scheduling landing page built from white cards with hairline borders floating on an off-white canvas, where black is the only accent — reserved for CTAs, section badges and the selected calendar day. The hero pairs a three-line display headline and stacked auth buttons with a functional-looking booking widget (duration pills, timezone row, month grid), so the product demos itself above the fold. Below the hero the rhythm alternates between centred badge–headline–CTA sections and denser grids: three numbered step cards, a 2×2 bento of feature cards each embedding a real UI fragment (settings dropdowns, booking URL, mini week calendar, notification toast), an 8-tile icon grid, a masonry testimonial wall, an accordion FAQ and a final CTA with award laurels, closing on an unusually deep footer with platform download badges, compliance marks and multi-column links.
